title: Git status panel tests: the submodule tree's full-path accessibility check runs without the app stylesheet
outcome: Low from the w-745943376089 review, round 5. The Codex reviewer, delegation-6084cec6, raised it at ui/src/panels/GitStatusPanel.test.tsx:256 on candidate e077c996, and the coordinator downgraded it from Medium. Vitest imports GitStatusPanel without the application's styles.css. A future stylesheet rule that hid the full-path text with display:none would therefore not fail the accessibility test. Neither reviewer found a present stylesheet defect. The DOM assertions already catch missing ownership, hidden, aria-hidden and inline display:none, and a committed Chromium fixture checks the runtime one-line and ellipsis layout. If coverage is added, it should check the rendered behaviour with the real stylesheet, never the CSS text.
acceptance: Git status panel tests: the submodule tree's full-path accessibility check runs without the app stylesheet is done
